image.crop.empty: An empty layer cannot be cropped
image.crop.hint: Crop — drag handles to resize, drag inside to move · Enter to apply · Esc to cancel (the original is preserved)
image.quick.combine.hint: Mix PDF, DOCX, HWPX, PPTX, XLSX and images
image.quick.combine.desc: Combines documents, slides, spreadsheets, PDFs and images into one PDF in the order you choose. Each file gets a bookmark, and PDF pages go in unchanged. You are asked for the password of protected files.
image.quick.merge.desc: Merges several PDFs into one in the order you choose. Drag to reorder.
image.quick.compress-pdf.desc: Leaves text and vectors as they are and reduces size by tidying object streams and recompressing images. If the file does not get smaller, the original is kept.
image.quick.pdf-jpg.desc: Converts each page of a PDF into a JPG image. Multiple images are saved as one ZIP.
image.quick.img-pdf.hint: Several JPG, PNG or WebP files → PDF
image.quick.img-pdf.desc: Combines several images into one PDF. JPG and PNG are embedded at original quality without recompression.
image.quick.compress-img.desc: Reduces photo file size using the quality and maximum dimensions you set. If the result is larger than the original, the original is kept.
image.quick.to-jpg.hint: PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF… → JPG (up to 50)
image.quick.to-jpg.desc: Converts images in various formats to JPG. Transparent areas are filled with white. This engine cannot decode HEIC.
